title: Daily 5, Tue 17 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: An item is marked at ₹1,200 and sold at a 25% discount. Find the selling price (in ₹).
A man walks to the station at 6 km/h. If he walked at 5 km/h instead, he would take 12 minutes longer. How far is the station, in km?
The sum of two numbers is 50 and their difference is 14. What is the larger number?
What is the largest integer x with 4x − 7 < 20?
15 men finish a job in 24 days. How many days will 20 men take at the same rate?
